Author: Lane #1644 (Codex), 2026-10-26.

These six lists contain direct mechanism uses, selected by resolved Go objects and method signatures in capabilitycensus.DirectMechanisms over workcensus. Transitive callers, loops, unrelated assertions and textual hits are context. Each row pins the expression and containing owner and records an individual read-based disposition. New, removed or changed members fail TestCapabilityExecutionPopulationCoverage until reviewed. TestFoundationDirectMechanismPopulation plants direct uses outside the package and rejects both missing registration and self-approval; transitive callers and same-named non-contract services stay outside membership.

The independent policy guard rejects a second structural walk even if registered. Executable Engine/public obligation and stored-view properties supply behavior; a proof test name alone does not. Sources unrelated to a selected owner are not approvals and do not require individual semantic classification. Engine implementations and stored views remain complete, separately checked interface populations.

The configuration handoff class selects exact compiled field stores; TestFoundationConfigurationWriterIdentity plants an unfamiliar multidb writer. Search consumers select actual Service method and adapter-field identities; TestFoundationSearchConsumerIdentity excludes a same-named unrelated service. The separate ../foundation-batch-point.tsv lists all 37 typed batch implementations, checked by TestFoundationBatchPointPopulationCoverage and the outside-package renamed signature control.
